title: 해양경비법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00581:20230203:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Appendix (Regulations for the Enforcement of the Fisheries Act, No. 581, February 3, 2023)

Article 1 (Effective Date) This regulation shall take effect from the date of its publication.

Articles 2 through 13 are omitted.

Article 14 (Amendments to Other Regulations) ① through <17> are omitted.

<18> The following portions of the "Regulations for the Enforcement of the Maritime Patrol Act" are amended:

Article 3, Paragraph 1, Item 4, which reads "Article 8 of the 'Fisheries Act'," is changed to "Article 7 of the 'Fisheries Act'."

Article 15 is omitted.
